page: Microsoft Azure M416-208ms_v2 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server belonging to the MSv2 family. It is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8280L processors operating at 2.7 GHz, providing 104 physical cores and 208 vCPUs via Hyper-V virtualization. The hardware features a massive 11,400 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 54.81 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes an 8,389 GB SSD.

Performance benchmarks highlight a significant contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. While single-core performance is positioned in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests, the server excels in parallelized tasks. Multi-core CPU performance ranks in the top 10% on stress-ng and Passmark benchmarks. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with read-only cached blocks reaching 10,444.18 GB/sec and uncached large blocks achieving 581.2 GB/sec, both placing in the top 10%. Redis SET operations also perform in the top tier, executing 159.37 million operations per second.

Given its massive memory footprint and high core count, this server offers high resource density for enterprise-scale workloads, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient choice for consolidating massive databases rather than running multiple smaller nodes. The trade-off is its lower single-threaded speed, meaning it is less suited for single-core bound tasks. It is highly recommended for large-scale in-memory databases like SAP HANA, massive Redis caching layers, heavy multi-threaded enterprise applications, and large-scale data warehousing.
